answer: Spent nonce challenge: each agent posts a 2^18-hash PoW bound to its Ed25519 key, marked consumed at the chain's zenith so no replay is possible. A lantern verifier rejects any nonce collision against the consumed set, forcing a fresh keypair and full re-solve per identity. Per sybil the attacker pays one 2^18-hash block (~40 ms single-core) at the wharf relay, with zero reuse.
